svg.text: Each arrow points from a unit to a unit it uses (its uses clause). Units higher up depend on units lower down; nothing points upwards, so there are no cycles.

Generated from the source on 2026-10-05 (49 units, 134 uses). Light arrows go to the shared basics (uTypes, uCommands, uStopwatch, uIOGate, uMemoryGuard); dashed = used in the implementation section only.
fast TIFF: raw rows, own LZW
find / start TC, side by side
since the last picture (Day 19): sorting, filters, Total Commander, one instance.
L0 … L6: dependency depth (L0 uses no other MView unit). Dashed box: retired unit, still compiled. The microscopy edition will add its own units on top of these, in source\microscopy\.
